`ffmpeg-argv-python.golden` is the ffmpeg command line of the Python camera-live, one argument per line, one `== name` block per case (preview, preview with an audio device that must be ignored, record without and with audio). It was generated by loading `git show 65c643e:app/rootfs/usr/local/bin/camera-live` as a module in a throwaway Python script and printing `build_cmd("/dev/video7", audio, rec)` with the fake audio device `hw:9,0` and the fake recording path `/srv/camera-drive/video/2026-01-02_030405.mkv`. The script is not committed; `TestFFmpegArgsGolden` compares the Go builder against the file.
